summary_bullets: Sanitize step3 loop envelope KVs so CR/LF in PLAN_REVIEW_CONTINUE_REASON no longer blocks result-env writes
Omit multiline SCOPE_ANCHOR_FILE values instead of stripping path characters
Surface phase_driver_write_result_env failures via emit and WARN= instead of silent || true
commit_message:
Fix step3 loop envelope CR/LF sanitization and write-failure visibility

Strip CR/LF from PLAN_REVIEW_CONTINUE_REASON before FD3 emission and durable persistence; omit invalid multiline SCOPE_ANCHOR_FILE values rather than repairing them; sanitize merged continue reasons from existing result env; emit visible WARN when phase_driver_write_result_env fails. Add offline harness regressions for sanitization, merge fallback, and symlink write failure.
